title: The completed strict Koszul quotient augmentation on Roos models
statement: For T, a completed adic coefficient datum d on A, and a finite family a generating d.ideal, form the explicit chain Koszul fibre functor of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction-models] and the Roos fibre of the ordinary strict quotient tensor tower. There is a natural chain map from the former to the latter. It is a quasi-isomorphism on every unbounded K-flat complex over the completed coefficient sheaf. Its composite with the actual degree-zero Koszul unit is the ordinary quotient unit followed by the zero-second-coordinate Roos kernel comparison. All three functors and units in this assertion are fixed independently of the augmentation.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion, strict augmentation argument; More on Algebra, sequence-Koszul-complexes (Tag 091N)

proof.text: Augment the exterior Koszul complex on a_i^(m+1) in degree zero by A to A/I^(m+1), with zero negative components. The diagonal transitions commute with quotient maps. Noetherian Koszul augmentation cones are pro-zero in the derived category; generator powers are cofinal with ideal powers.

Exact constant sheafification and flat completed scalar extension transport these augmentations and pro-zero cones. Identify finite quotient sheaves with the recorded finite function coefficient modules, respecting their projections. Tensor with C and form the induced product/fibre chain maps.

For K-flat C, tensor preserves derived-zero transition maps. The strict derived-limit Roos theorem kills the pro-zero cone and identifies the explicit fibre map as a quasi-isomorphism. Exact countable products supply the concrete Roos computation.
The exterior degree-zero unit goes to the quotient of one. Products and the zero second coordinate preserve this equality, giving the displayed chain-level equation.

theorem completedKoszulQuotientRoosAugmentation
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal) :
    ∃ α : reconstructionKoszulFiberFunctor T d r a ⟶
        (completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          ExactProductsRoos.fibre,
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := completedAdicCommRing T d) P →
          QuasiIso (α.app P)) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ,
        completedAdicKoszulUnitComplex T d r a P ≫ α.app P =
          (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (reconstructionOrdinaryUnit T d) (.up ℤ)).app P ≫
            ExactProductsRoos.comparison.app
              (((completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
